population: Next 64 SHA-ordered M0B-eligible canonical train queries after SEM-A0B v1/v2, excluding M0C, M1, M2B, OBS-A1 and FRAG-B0
eligible_definition: exact_quote is a nonempty contiguous substring of future_atom
canonical_fact is affirmative and every predicate/entity/number/qualifier is entailed by exact_quote
canonical_fact adds information not already present in S6
annotation: Two independent human annotators, blinded to outcomes and one another; adjudicate disagreements only after initial forms are locked
reliability_gate: raw label agreement >=0.85 and Cohen kappa >=0.70
go_gate: Adjudicated ELIGIBLE >=24/64 and direct annotator agreement on ELIGIBLE >=20/64, with reliability gate passed
gray_zone: 16-23/64: no generator training; inspect frozen abstain-reason distribution
